workload.description: Verified open recording replayed over the same UDP transport; no synthetic signal values. The display consumer is deliberately over-subscribed so the buffer overflows.
workload.aggregation: summary[] holds the median of the repeats; each cell also carries the observed min/max so the host-dependent spread stays visible
workload.per_packet_fold_cost: measured, not injected: the consumer folds every accepted packet into a real ViewState (~0.2 ms/packet on the reference machine), so draining a large backlog costs real time
workload.audio_archiving: disabled: WAV writing puts file I/O on the parse thread and would conflate display-buffer behaviour with disk latency
workload.note: udp_delivery_ratio is received/sent and therefore includes kernel and transport loss; parse_yield is parsed/received and isolates the parser. Do not report either as a lossless guarantee.
